$comment: Conformance entries this grammar cannot decide, with the reason for each.
Every entry here is a negative syntax test that a context-free token DFA
cannot reject: the constraint is on a value, not on a shape. Lezer is an
error-tolerant grammar for painting and navigation, and the parser that
decides whether a document is valid is a separate concern; a grammar that
tried to encode these would be larger, slower and still incomplete.
The list is asserted exactly — a test that starts passing must be removed
here, and a test that stops passing is a failing build, not a new entry.
Add an entry only with a reason that says why the grammar cannot decide it.

turtle12.turtle12-surrogate-pair-bad-01: UCHAR pair validity: the escapes are lexically well-formed and only their combined code point is invalid.
turtle12.turtle12-surrogates-bad-01: Lone/misordered surrogate escapes: needs code-point arithmetic across two UCHARs.

ntriples12.ntriples-langdir-bad-3: rdf:langString without a language tag is a datatype constraint, not a syntactic one.
ntriples12.ntriples-langdir-bad-5: rdf:dirLangString without a direction is a datatype constraint, not a syntactic one.
ntriples12.ntriples12-bad-iri-1: N-Triples requires absolute IRIs; deciding that means resolving a scheme, not matching a token.
